title: React Examples
description: Copy-ready React 19 components for common tasks: counters, controlled forms, lists, data loading, context, custom hooks, refs, routing, form Actions and memoization. Paste them into a Vite project; they do not run inside this site.

examples.title: Counter with useState
examples.description: The smallest useful stateful component: increment, decrement and reset with updater functions and a disabled state.
examples.output:
After clicking +1 three times:

Count: 3

and the Reset button is enabled.

examples.title: Controlled sign-up form
examples.description: One state object for several fields, a shared change handler, live validation that disables the submit button, and a confirmation message.
examples.output:
After entering Ada, ada@example.com and Pro, then submitting:

Welcome, Ada! You chose the pro plan.

examples.title: Todo list with add, toggle and remove
examples.description: A list in state updated immutably with spread, map and filter, stable ids as keys, and an empty-state message.
examples.output:
After adding "Buy milk" and "Write code" and ticking the first: two list items, the first struck through; deleting both shows

Nothing to do.

examples.title: Fetch with loading, error and cancellation
examples.description: Loads a post in an effect, handles HTTP errors, and aborts the request in the cleanup so a changed id never shows stale data.
examples.output:
renders

Loading…

, then an article whose heading is "sunt aut facere repellat provident occaecati excepturi optio reprehenderit".

examples.title: Theme context with toggle
examples.description: A provider that owns the theme state, the React 19 provider syntax, and a useTheme hook that throws when the provider is missing.
examples.output: Initially <main class="page light"> with the button "Switch to dark mode"; after one click <main class="page dark"> with "Switch to light mode".

examples.title: useLocalStorage hook
examples.description: A drop-in replacement for useState that persists the value in localStorage, with a lazy initializer and a guard against unreadable storage.
examples.output: After typing Ada and unticking the box, localStorage holds name → "\"Ada\"" and notifications → "false"; both survive a reload.

examples.title: Focus an input when a dialog opens
examples.description: A ref on the input and an effect that runs once after mount, the standard way to move keyboard focus into a dialog.
examples.output: When the dialog mounts, the search input has keyboard focus: document.activeElement is the input.

examples.title: Router with layout, params and 404
examples.description: A complete main.jsx for React Router 7: a shared layout with NavLinks and an Outlet, an index route, a dynamic article route and a catch-all.
examples.output:
At /articles/hooks the main area shows

Thinking in hooks

and the Articles link carries class="active"; at /nowhere it shows

Page not found

.

examples.title: User list with TanStack Query
examples.description: QueryClientProvider at the root, a useQuery with staleTime, and a refresh button driven by isFetching.
examples.output:
A list of ten users starting with
  • Leanne Graham (Sincere@april.biz)
    • ; clicking Refresh shows "Refreshing…" until the new response arrives.

examples.title: Contact form with a React 19 Action
examples.description: An async form action with validation and error state through useActionState, and a submit button that reads pending state with useFormStatus.
examples.output:
Submitting "hi" shows

Please write at least 10 characters.

; after a successful send the form shows

Thanks, your message was sent.

and the textarea is cleared.

examples.title: Memoized filtered catalog
examples.description: useMemo caches the filtered list across unrelated re-renders and memo keeps unchanged rows from re-rendering.
examples.output:
With items Pen 1.50, Lamp 24.00 and Desk 180.00 and the default max price of 100:

2 of 3 items

followed by the rows "Pen – 1.50" and "Lamp – 24.00".

examples.title: Tabs built by composition
examples.description: A reusable Tabs component that receives its panels as data containing JSX, with ARIA roles and aria-selected for accessibility.
examples.output:
Initially the panel shows

Solid oak desk, 140 × 70 cm.

; clicking Reviews shows

No reviews yet.

and that button gets aria-selected="true".
